title: AdaFrame

items: Hierarchical Multimodal Deduplication with Adaptive Information Budgeting
Video advertisement analysis with a content-dependent frame budget
arXiv v1, October 13, 2026

note: 场景是视频广告的帧选择及分析。文中 dedup 主要是视频内部冗余帧，不应理解成全库视频去重系统。

title: Uniform sampling spends tokens on redundancy

items: Repeated or static frames consume VLM inputs with limited extra evidence.
Human-oriented video summaries may omit details useful to machine extraction.
The proposed cascade filters cheap redundancy before semantic selection and VLM inference.

note: 目标任务包括 topic、sentiment、effectiveness。对长电影或安全关键瞬时事件不能直接套用广告的预算策略。

title: Semantic energy combines change and salience

items: Semantic velocity is the mean CLIP distance between adjacent frames.
Attention yield combines text, face, and opening/closing positional cues.
Semantic energy multiplies temporal change by average attention yield.

note: 权重为 0.4、0.35、0.25，作者在 50 个 held-out ads 上调节。这些 salience 先验明显与广告任务相关。第 4.2 节。

title: ISD caps the information budget

items: Center the frame embedding matrix and compute its singular values.
ISD is the smallest rank explaining 90% of squared singular-value energy.
The frame budget combines duration/energy growth with an ISD-derived ceiling.

note: ISD 是 embedding 的有效维度代理，不是视频中真实事件数量，也不保证短暂但重要内容必被保留。

title: Tier 1 uses perceptual-hash voting

items: Compute pHash, dHash, and wHash for each frame.
A pair counts as duplicate when at least two hashes have Hamming distance below threshold 10.
One representative per group advances to the next stage.

note: hash voting 面向近像素重复。单次 hash 比较便宜，但全体候选的配对策略仍影响总复杂度。第 4.3.1 节。

title: Tier 2 removes perceptual variants

items: AlexNet-based LPIPS compares surviving frames.
The default merge threshold is 0.15.
This catches lighting and minor appearance changes that survive hash voting.

note: LPIPS 较小表示感知相似，不保证任务语义完全一致，例如 OCR 小字变化仍可能重要。第 4.3.2 节。

title: Tier 3 balances semantics and time

items: CLIP ViT-B/32 embeddings enter k-means with K derived from ISD.
Temporal-aware NMS subtracts a proximity penalty from attention yield.
Selection favors informative representatives spread over the timeline.

note: 默认 temporal decay 2 秒、lambda 0.3。跨时间分散能减少邻近帧扎堆，但也可能稀释连续动作证据。第 4.3.3 节。

title: Audio and text remain separate inputs

items: The system integrates Whisper-large-v3 transcription and Tesseract OCR.
Selected visual frames join audio/text signals for VLM extraction.
Removing visual frames changes only one part of the multimodal pipeline cost.

note: 不要把 VLM 输入费用下降当成 decode、CLIP、LPIPS、ASR、OCR 与存储总成本下降。第 4.4 与 5.3 节。

title: Published results on 500 advertisements
note: 表 2，Gemini 2.5 Flash。主 sentiment metric 使用句向量相似度大于 0.7，不能当成 30 类 exact-match accuracy。

title: Baselines and quality definitions

items: Nine baselines include random, scene detection, CLIP-only, DSNet, and native video input.
All methods use the same 500 randomly sampled Pitt Ads videos.
The reported 48% fewer frames and 75% lower cost refer to Uniform-1FPS and VLM expenses.

note: sentiment exact match 约 30%，论文采用语义匹配为主指标。费用受当时 API 定价、token 和输入方式影响。

title: Failure modes and implementation status

items: Advertisement-specific salience can miss brief, subtle, or non-salient events.
Thresholds and ISD depend on the embedding space and candidate sampling.
The paper says code will be released upon publication. No dedicated public repository is verified here.

note: 不要伪造 code 链接。500 ads 与单一主 provider 的结果不足以证明任意视频数据管线总成本下降 75%。

title: A bounded evaluation proposal

items: Compare all selectors at matched frame and VLM-token budgets on a new domain.
Measure preprocessing wall time, OCR/ASR costs, extraction quality, and total expense.
Audit short events, text changes, and human disagreement before adopting frame deletion.

note: 以上是拟议应用与复现路径，尚未执行。可以保存被删帧的索引及理由，支持回溯错误和重新预算。
